code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild anemia, mild thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, monocytosis and basophilia, and increased red cell distribution width. Glucose is slightly low. These findings may suggest a possible underlying hematologic disorder or bone marrow suppression; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended. Other parameters are within normal limits.
